It lives at altitudes of 500–2000 m.
One locality of this species in Menghai (Yunnan, Xishuangbanna) is situated at the subtropics.
The habitat is tea plantation, adjacent to primeval forests with high temperature and humidity, and plenty of sunlight.

This species is special in this group due to its strong cupreous metallic luster, the pronotal disc having 3–5 rows of fine punctures, and lateral metasternum with a long and arcuate strip of pubescence.
